design: Eight eligible candidate families x8 source pairs x8 context templates. Four training-context templates and four validation-context templates, crossed with source slots0-3 versus4-7. Retain all native outcomes and all18 layer writes. No original whole-task holdouts enter this bank.
split: Discovery contexts0-3 sources0-3 only may train. Lexical contexts0-3 sources4-7, structural contexts4-7 sources0-3, joint contexts4-7 sources4-7. Exact train/validation prompt disjointness asserted BEFORE evaluation. Within-training sentiment/negation prompt reuse retained and counted.
gate: Per family/context/source-half: >=4 distinct token-valid pairs, >=.75 both-correct and >=.5 full-vocabulary. Only discovery-cohort gates control training eligibility; evaluation gates never select training.
limits: New contexts reuse historical lexical items; this is prospective context expansion, not entirely fresh vocabulary. Capital source pairs rebuilt with disjoint countries to avoid endpoint leakage. Country-language belongs mainly toMLP13; retain all layers rather than pool layer coordinates. Native competence does not establish causal transfer.
purpose: Produce expanded concrete training bank for joint-featurizer comparison.
